# Vendored from MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search

- Source: https://github.com/MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search (commit 1cecaec)
- File: `.agents/skills/linkedin-search/cli/src/helpers.ts` -> `linkedin-search/helpers.ts` (unchanged)
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

Used by `src/adapters/job-search.ts` to search LinkedIn's public jobs-guest
endpoints and parse job detail pages. Upstream note, kept here on purpose:
automated access is against LinkedIn's Terms of Service; personal use only,
keep volume low. Apply2Interview never submits applications on LinkedIn.
